bindings.label: A woman in her 50s presented to the emergency department after a fall
She reported being clumsy her entire life, with worsening difficulty with balance over the past few years
She occasionally had falls, which were sometimes preceded by vertigo and 'shaking' episodes
Brain MRI shows a fat-containing lesion at the cerebellopontine angle with nodular enhancement of the soft-tissue component
Brain MRI also revealed mild cerebellar atrophy
Epidermoid or dermoid cyst at the cerebellopontine angle causing local mass effect
Epidermoid cyst at the cerebellopontine angle causing local mass effect
Dermoid cyst at the cerebellopontine angle causing local mass effect
Cerebellar atrophy leading to progressive imbalance
